t: Listen to Zayan, sneak into the Darkblood Citadel, defeat vampire guardians, and hack Amadeus' security system.

Finally! I thought my letter was intercepted...

Are you surprised that we meet so secretly? Then listen closely. This is very important. Important for you. Important for me. Important for the whole world.

After I obtained the Grain of Protopower - thanks to you - and handled the beam of the Darkblood Citadel that was tearing my allod apart, I had plenty of time to think about the things happening in Sarnaut. I have found out something... very important!
Don't get distracted. We need to get an access to Amadeus before the guards eat us!

Oh... Amadeus was created by a true genius. It's not just an artificial intelligence, is a work of art! It is pure perfection, and believe me, I know what I'm saying. I'm in love with it!

Well, enough with the talking. Ferris is straight ahead!

Greetings! I've heard a lot about your deeds, and honestly, I'm happy that a hero like you is joining us for our research mission. I'm sure together we will find the answers to all the questions that are bothering you!

Now here is the deal. The Citadel's main weapon, the destructive beam, was eliminated, but there are still lots of bloodsuckers inside. Still the real threat comes from Amadeus, the spirit of the Citadel. I hope I can reprogram it. Our faith in Light will protect us from the darkness that has saturated these walls!

Are you with us?
Use the Hopping Backpack to reach Ferris.

Here comes Ferris! Look at its beautiful shores! And how the sun gleams on the tops of its snowy mountains!

You don't see any shores or mountains? Hahaha! Neither do I. Damned storm! How are we supposed to land? Are we supposed to sail blindly through the blizzard in our rusty little boats? I'm a Surveyor, not a self-killer!

Listen, I have an idea. We have three Hopping Backpacks with embedded meteorite particles. The goblins made us pay through the nose for them, but I had a feeling that we might need them. And so it happened.

You are the most experienced in that kind of things among us, so we rely on your skills. Take the backpack, reach the shore, and install the landing beacons. Their light will help us land.

Murk, our best scout, will go with you, as well as Elena, my assistant and the most beautiful Historian, I swear on my thesis paper! Please, look after them.
Well, the landing was not that soft...

Comrade! I have an urgent notification for you. Strangely enough, it's not from Yasker or even from the Council. It was sent from Avilon personally by Great Mage Zayan.

He expresses sincere gratitude to you and to the Empire and asks you to arrive to his allod immediately.

If you wish to go to Avilon, you can take the ship that departs from the Nezebgrad Port.

Have a nice day, comrade!
You have received my letter? Excellent!

How are you doing? I have a message for you, from Zayan the Mage, written with his own hand.

The Great Mage asks you to come to Avilon as soon as possible, but does not say why. He also says that this is a matter of great importance, and it directly concerns your past adventures.

If you are going to Avilon, take the next ship that leaves from the Port! It will take you to Avilon in no time.
You have received my letter? Excellent!
Destroy the Ice Wall and break through the ice cave. Talk to Elena Zimina.

I don't know how about you, but I am sick and tired of this icy wasteland. I can't get rid of the feeling that my wings are about to turn into ice and break into pieces...

It's time to act! We are ready to break through the obstacle that, as the local aborigines assume, separates us from the divine world.

Go to the cave and destroy the wall. Elena and Murk will follow you shortly and help you after you eliminate it. I can't wait to see what's behind it!
I think I miss the snow...
We did it! I can't believe it. I don't understand what caused such a turmoil among the Tungars. It doesn't seem like their mysterious gods ever used to live here...
Find a way to enter the Bestiary. Report to Vincent Trickov at the Eastern Terminal.

Well... As much as Herbert cares about our safety, we need to continue the research! Obviously the Bestiary holds the key to many answers. What was the Empire doing here? I'm just curious as a scientist, I'm not going to run to the League Defenders and report on it.

We have found the entrance. Now we just need to unlock it! And really doubt it is opened for all visitors. If someone managed to evacuate during that tumult, they must have sealed all the doors. Murk mentioned that he saw some decomposed bodies not far from the place were you blacked out. Maybe we should search them? I bet my microscope those were scientists trying to escape.

Come back as soon as you find a way to open the door. The expedition still needs your help, and I really hate to take your precious time.
I really doubt that the Bestiary will help us find out anything about Tep. But we have plenty of mysteries apart from that!

So, those scientists perished after all? I'm sorry to hear that. At least the passage is opened now - thanks to the code.

When you enter the Bestiary, be careful. You have no chance in there unless you go with a squad of warriors as strong as you are.

The skeleton was wearing a tattered robe that resembles Imperial uniform of the scientists from the vision. The stained patch on the sleeve reads "Vasily Dankin". So he didn't manage to escape after all.

There is a square object under the scientists' bones. What could it possibly be?
Picture damaged parts of the Mana Station, pillars, and train cars. Bring the pictures to Luville de Ardeur at the Eastern Terminal.

Hey, hello again! I'm a little too busy now, so I could use your help. No, it doesn't involve killing! Why so bloodthirsty?

Herbert thinks that we've been here for far too long, and I agree with him. But there is one small problem... What we are looking for is most likely hidden in the depths of the research center, which is located far in the mountains. The whole expedition won't make it on foot. The only way to reach it is by the Manarail. Yes, the one that seems irreparably broken! Astral damn those genius Imperial architects.

Somehow, I will have to miraculously improvise a new rail! But before we get down to work, I need to understand the scale of the damage. I will need your help with that. Take this Desorotype. I hope you remember how to use it? Please take some pictures of the Mana Station, the pillars, and the train cars and come back. We'll see what can be done about them.
Are the pictures ready? Come on, hurry up!
You must be an experienced Deserotypist! Thank you, it shows everything that we need. So... let's begin!
Escort Zimina to the strange building and wait until she finishes the inspection. Talk to her afterwards.

Huh... Do you see that, too? I thought my eyes were failing me. This heavenly place is just one cave away from that snowy hole. And here it is early autumn! Unbelievable!

Okay, we will rejoice later. We still have problems to solve. See those buildings on the horizon? Don't they seem kind of... Imperial? Phew! It means, I'm not hallucinating. If you see them, too, they are actually there. We should inspect them! Let's get closer and take a look. I'm not an expert in architecture, but we will definitely find something out.

I don't like these strange machines that ramble around... They may be slow, but they still look menacing. Watch out for them!
It gets more interesting with every second!

Well, our eyes didn't fail us. This tower was actually built by the Empire. Which is rather weird, but there can be no doubt about it - I found the plan of that building and of some others. They all are designated as parts a complex called "The Bestiary". The most interesting thing is, all equipment details and schemes are marked under the date of year 965. As you remember, that was the time when Nezeb reigned over the Empire...

But we cannot stop. We need to move on.
Obtain 10 mechanical parts by destroying Mechanoids M-1. Bring them to Elena Zimina at the Watchout Cliff.

These Mechanoids give me the creeps. Just look at them! Their armor is obviously Imperial-styled. And their wire-tangled heads... Brrr.

We need to collect and analyze all the available information. That is why we need to dismantle these Mechanoids to pieces. Imperial factory markings is something I am really versed in! You wouldn't believe how much information few letters and numbers can contain.

I will need several parts of the Mechanoids that attacked us. There must be plenty of them around here. Bring some 10 - it will be enough to specify the production factory.

Wire-tangled heads, oh my...
What are you waiting for? The expedition soon will be here, and we still don't know whether these Mechanoids are dangerous!

Oh... I'm confused. I was so sure that these Mechanoids belonged to the Empire, but now... I doubt. Well, they were obviously made out of Imperial parts. But the final assembling could have been performed by someone else. These markings don't match any Imperial factory markings!

Though they are dated as of 965, too. We can be certain about the fact that the buildings and the Mechanoids are directly related.

I think there is nothing more that we can learn from these Mechanoids, so I won't take any more of your time. Murk was walking ahead of us, but we haven't heard of him in a while. He can surely stand up for himself, but if you remember how it was back in the frozen lands... We better find him, and quick. Whatever trouble he has got in, help him out.

I will stay here to meet the rest of the expedition. Maybe I will learn something else about these buildings and the Mechanoids.
Who was that hunhurr who placed these damned machines here?!
Good job, kylys. Now we can walk on.
Eliminate 20 Mechanoids M-2 at the Eastern Terminal. Use the hand-held mortar to explode the barrels with fuel.

Ha! Frrankly, I was thinking of taking down the turrets with another thing. This one. Herbert calls it a hand-held mortar. I'm glad I have it with me. The tin cans we saw before are just rusty junk comparing to these machines.

You see that big building, zoor? It's the terminal, the trrain station. I think we can turn it into our headquarters. But first we need to make sure it's safe. That is where we might need the mortar.

The tin cans are strong, but stupid - they're prowling among explosive barrels. One spark would be enough to blow them all up, eysh! And this thing spits fire like a drragon, eysh! Wait until a tin can approaches a barrel, then shoot. Of course you can destroy them in any other way, but it's always better to use your head, zoor?

As soon as this place is safe, the expedition will settle near the terminal. Report to Herbert when you see him.

What for heaven's sake was that? It seemed as if the allod was splitting from the inside! We'd even started setting up for emergency evacuation. Fortunately, Elena told us what was going on.

I should have foreseen it. Murk just couldn't have resisted the temptation to try out the mortar. But I'm really surprised that he got you involved!

Ah, anyway... We have just arrived here, and we are already surrounded by mysteries. And that's wonderful! Mysteries are our expertise and our passion. Before we start working, we need to solve several pressing problems. Talk to the members of the expedition and help them with that.
Eliminate 10 Mechanoids M-3. Report to Yasskul Mekhdi at the Eastern Terminal.

Judging by the amount of craters, you and Murk had a blast here. But your job still isn't done, though! Mechanoids are still prowling around the Terminal and keep on attacking our scientists. This is absolutely unacceptable!

Unfortunately, we don't have efficient means of fighting back against these nasty machines. I'm afraid, this is the case when we can only use... brute force! Yours, of course.

I assign you the task of dealing with ten Mechanoids around the terminal. Report to me as soon as you're done. There are surely more than just ten of them, but I understand that you have other things to do. Just stay alert to the real threat, and not only to the ghosts of the past!
That would be a shame if the brightest minds of the Surveyors were killed by some rusty mechanical rudiments!
Excellent! It wasn't that hard, was it? Now we are both happy, and I can work safely. Thank you!
Eliminate the Mechanoid Suppressor M-3 and obtain a Mana Generator. Bring it to Luville de Ardeur at the Eastern Terminal.

Oh... hello! I'm Luville. Luville de Ardeur, the technician. Have we met already? Sorry, there are so many new things to remember that I get confused easily... Oh Great Astral, why, why would I have joined this expedition? It's even worse than Asee-Teph! It was warm there, at least. Here you can't even shower properly. You have to use a perforated bucket, and Choof pours water in it. Taking shower with Choof is just what I dreamed of!

Listen, I need to ask you of something. I happen to be a technician. Yes, don't get wide-eyed! I can come up with a power supply system for the Terminal... Actually, I have already come up with it, but I don't have the main thing. The source of power! Happily, this is something we can obtain. We need to find the biggest and the most powerful Mechanoid and dismantle it. Can you do that?

Please, please, please! If I don't test my mechanical shower in the next 24 hours, I will die!
Oh... Dirt! Dirt under my nails! Oh, what have I done to deserve that?!

Oh! Oh! I can feel that energy! Weeks of work! The buzz of the engines! The lamp light! And the sound of water in the bathroom! You are my savior. We will need power all the time, so don't forget to bring some more of these from time to time!
Examine the wreckage and the remains in the field near the abandoned Terminal. Report to the Prowl Family at the Eastern Terminal.

Hi! We are prowling around in search for anything interesting. We are even called the Prowl Family, haha!

See how wrecked everything is? That was a hell of a fight! I wish we'd seen it. The question is, who was fighting who? This is what we are going to find out. Wanna help us?

Perfect! Your task is simple - examine everything on that distant battlefield. Check every shatter, every rotten bone. Probably something will come up. We're gonna take a break meanwhile, huh.
So, have you found anything interesting?

Tep Cultists and his walking tin cans? Well, there's no wonder. Our Elven brainiac assumed that Tep was somehow involved here. This is one more evidence of that.

But who has gnawed the poor orc and the Imperial Mechanoid, that's the question. Sometimes we bite in battle, too, but no one has died of that yet, huh! Alright, jokes aside. Some unknown beast may be lurking about, and we don't even know what it is. What if it devours us while we sleep? If it really has that big jaws, we are in some real danger!
Suspicious dents and scratches can be seen on the Mechanoid body. Looks like some giant beast tried to taste it. One should rather stay away from that creature.
The wreckage of the Imperial Mechanoid has been lying here for so long it got fleeced with moss and inhabited by an ant colony.
Talk to Elena Zimina, Yasskul Mekhdi, and Choof the Forester about the "Gates" object and Tep Cultists. Report to the Prowl Family.

Here's what's also strange. The Imperial Mechanoid looks really old. And the orc's corpse has decomposed to the bones. But that Tep's henchman looks as if he died yesterday! I know those Arisen always look well for their age, huh, but still... The Tep's Mechanoid still hasn't lost its polish. You know what it means? It means, that there were at least two battles at this field! And that means... Astral knows what it means. Tep's followers were here relatively recently, and Imperial Mechanoids obviously didn't like their presence. That's all we can draw from that.

We have more citizens of the Empire in our expedition than there are ale barrels on Frozen Frontier. We should question them. I bet my boots Zimina knows something, I can tell it from the look in her eyes... And don't forget Mekhdi. He's crude, but secrets often hide beneath crudeness. And also Choof! I really doubt he can give us anything, but we should give it a try.

Ask carefully, don't arouse suspicion.
Everyone must be tired of answering our questions. Maybe you'll be more lucky?

Mekhdi said that? That ZIT Headquarters is a cemetery? Haha! That's rather precise, actually. A cemetery of living dead! And Choof is not that simple, as it turns out. He went over to us from Gorluxor right in time. And as for Zimina, she remains a dark horse. And I will bite Murk's tail if Herbert is not in love with her!

Well, it's all fun, but we haven't found out anything that mattered. That's a shame. Well, time will tell us what is going on. Maybe it's even more interesting that way.
Obtain 12 Skins of Brown Deer and bring them to the Prowl Family at the Eastern Terminal.

Oh these milksops! All of them - Herbert, the Xadaganian and the Elven girls, and that rugged Kanian Vincent - they all whine about getting cold at night. They thought that since they were out of the snow, they didn't need warm clothes anymore. And we can't give them our skins, can we? Even if we could, they would only make a loincloth for them, haha.

But what we can do is obtain someone else's skins for them. And we have the perfect candidates! The local deer just can't wait to become our blankets and tents. We should do them that favor.

Bring a dozen of skins, and we will find a way to thank you. We can't listen to their whining anymore!
If they are so cold, they could have thought of something themselves instead of distracting brave heroes from their deeds! Don't be so shy, we mean it!

Nice skins! I can see the hand of an experienced hunter. You must have fetched many skins, and a lot of meat? Well, that's no surprise, haha.

Thank you very much!
Find the source of the radiation, collect 15 samples, and bring them to Vincent Trickov at the Eastern Terminal.

Oh, it's you! I've been expecting you. It seems like I have discovered something rather curious. Remember that strange radiation that we discovered in the icy lowlands? By the lake? When you... fell through the ice. I discovered the same type of radiation here, but its spreading pattern is very, very peculiar. It's like there are lots of tiny sources of that radiation!

We need to find out what they are as soon as possible. I will give you the Magimeter - I suppose you are already familiar with it. It is perfectly calibrated, so you just need to go to the designated area and find out what is the source of the radiation.

Will you do that? I pin my hopes on you!
I have developed 42 theories, from most innocent to most disastrous. And it's been just half an hour since we found it!

Erm... droppings? Are you sure? Huh. That's really weird.

I wonder if we have a waste-product expert in the expedition?
Obtain 10 skin samples of the Strange Echidnas and bring them to Vincent Trickov at the Eastern Terminal.

Unfortunately, we don't have anyone with such expertise. We will have to figure this out on our own... Let's think.

If the droppings radiate the emission, it means that something's wrong with the food. Judging be the place where we've found them, we can assume that these are droppings of a carnivore. And carnivores feed on weaker animals. So... there must be something wrong with the prey. As far as I know, local predators prefer to hunt echidnas. So let's start with echidnas!

I think if we take a closer look at their skin, we may find something out. Please, bring me some ten samples. I am very curious about it!

Echidnas can be found to the East from here. They usually hide in the old sentry post and on uphill paths around it.
Let's hurry! It will be rather distressful if we all develop radiation sickness because of these droppings...

Erm... What is this? Is this skin? It looks really strange.

Something weird has happened to these echidnas. You say, they were behaving oddly? I see.

Look, the device has detected the very same radiation! Oh, I don't like it. Here is what we shall do...
Kill 12 Spotty Cougars by the Sentry Post and report to Vincent Trickov.

Now that we know where the most curious riddles of this part of Ferris are hidden, we can involve the rest of our colleagues. Research in the wild nature is very exciting. It's so exciting that you can forget about the deadly dangers. And they are all around us!

I'm speaking of cougars. These predators will surely gladly feast on us, since their old food seems to be not really edible. Could you please deal with that? I really don't want the crew to go through the stress of resurrection every time.

A dozen dead cougars will teach the cats a lesson.
I will do my best to prove that their death was not in vain. I suppose the Prowls have nothing to do again - it smells like beer all over the camp.
I'm extremely grateful! Now we can work safely.
Collect 10 Chain Links and ask Herbert de Vevre to help you craft a Trap Chain. Catch a Strange Cougar with the Chain Trap and bring it to Vincent Trickov at the Eastern Terminal.

All this resembles the Leper that once spread on Umoir. I really doubt that echidnas are the only animals who were affected by the mutation. We need another object for the study, preferably a bigger and a more interesting one... And this time it has to be alive!

If you see a "contaminated" cougar among the local cats, catch it and bring it here. You would contribute to the expedition greatly. Of course you will need a fine trap chain for that. I'm afraid we don't have such thing... So what do we do?

Oh, I know! I saw some old chains on the hill by those buildings. The links are rusty but still solid. You could craft something from them, and Herbert could help you. He said once that he was good with chains and ropes. Whatever it meant...

Be careful with the cougar. Most likely it will fight back. Try not to hurt it too bad!
Why has no one thought of recruiting a professional trapper? This was really, really foolish.

Great Tensess... What has happened to it? Why is it still alive after all these mutations? Are we dealing with another Leper here? What was the name of that complex on the scheme? The Bestiary? Well that's very curious...

Oh... What a power! You see, it hasn't even changed completely. And I have a little desire to see a completely mutated beast. But I'm afraid it's inevitable. Sooner or later we will have to deal with something more serious, mark my words.

Alright, let's stick to the bright side. Thank you for the help! I hope I will get as many answers from this creature as possible.
Kill the Strange Yak near the Sentry Post. Report to Yasskul Mekhdi.

It looks like your contribution has finally delivered benefits! And in a most unexpected way. Imagine my surprise when that mumbling Kanian asked me - a prominent engineer! - to dissect an animal. I thought your notorious radiation has finally reached his brain. But it turned out that my assistance was actually required.

You see, the innards of that cat resemble a complex system of bionic prosthetic devices, far more complicated and exquisite than those of the Arisen. Do you understand what it means? It's the ultimate path to perfection!

I'm sure there are creatures around here that have mutated more than that cougar. I need the most advanced one. As far as I remember, the Prowls said something about a strange yak near the Sentry Post. Go get it!
Great! I will send out a squad to the yak's corpse. I'm going to be granted the title of Negus for that discovery. Or even the Nomarkh!
Locate the main source of radiation, examine it, and report to Vincent Trickov.

I have very good news! I have calibrated the Magimeter using the cougar's vitals. The device has immediately detected a powerful source of radiation somewhere in the mountains. Probably, it is hidden in the depths of the Beastiary.

I have no idea what is inside of that complex. Anything could be there - even that mysterious gnawing creature that the Prowls keep talking about. In order to locate the source more precisely, we should take another measuring by the Sentry Post before we move on. Yes, a part of the discovery will belong to you again!

Please, be careful. Go back at any sign of danger!
I can't wait to find out what it is!

Oh, thanks Tensess! The whole camp is in a stir. Herbert has freaked out again. Even Murk and Elena don't dare to speak to him. They have pulled you out, by the way.

Wait, don't you remember anything at all?
Obtain Energy Elements from Mechanoids and install them into the power pillars of the Manarail at the Eastern Terminal. Return to Herbert de Vevre.

Ah, you're here! I have good news: Luville and her team have finally restored the Manarail. Now nothing is keeping us here, so we can move on into the heart of Ferris. I don't know what is waiting for us there. Well, as the Prowls say, it's more interesting that way!

Just one more thing. I wanted to stock up on some extra energy supplies to be on the safe side. Luville has crafted a special adapter so that we can use energy elements of the local Mechanoids. And that's what we will do.

Obtain several elements and bring them to me. I will calibrate the Mana Converter. You will just have to insert the energy elements into the power pillars and get ready to take off! I really hope we are not going to end up in an inceberg again...
All set, we just need you to bring the energy elements!

Great! Colleagues, now listen what I say! Board the train one after another! Don't push, don't crowd, there's plenty of room for everyone!

The train leaves in ten minutes!
Complete tasks from the expedition members until the way is clear. Then talk to Herbert de Vevre.

The further we move into the depths of Ferris, the more mysteries and deadly dangers we face. You can't stand aside when the lives of the Surveyors depend on you!

After this area is explored, you should ask Herbert how long the expedition is going to last in his opinion, and are there any chances that it will end successfully.
Ferris turned out to be much more unrelenting than I though at the beginning. Well, any experience is valuable, isn't it?

On behalf of the whole expedition I would like to thank you for all that you've done for us. I've been actually counting how many times you'd had to risk your life to protect us. And that's way too many. I can't imagine how much will, strength, and even luck it has took you!

I'm afraid I can't tell for sure how long this expedition is going to last. Maybe we're halfway there. Maybe we're just starting to see the light in the end of the tunnel. Or maybe we're still fumbling in the dark. Well, you know it all for yourself! And probably, you even know more than I do. But let's not waste our time on futile guessing. We should move on while we can. That's what scientists do!
Test the Master Controller on Mechanoid M-3. Report to Elena Zimina at the Eastern Terminal.

Good news! We must be in some kind of a "scientific quarter" of our mysterious predecessors. You know what it means? It means that very soon we will find the answers to even the most tricky questions. But first, we need to clear the way. These clanking Mechanoids are driving me insane!

Look what I've found. This must be some kind of controlling device. Don't look at me like that - it was just lying in plain sight in one of the abandoned houses. I haven't found any stationary unit it could be connected to, so I assume it has to do something with the Mechanoids.

Will you check it? Just point the antenna and push the button. I hope it will switch them off!
Well? How did the test-run go?

The codes... are obsolete? Well, at least this controller actually works. Damn it, I was sure it was going to work out!

Oh... I'm sorry, I wasn't completely honest with you. I will try to tell you everything now...

I should begin with saying that I'm working under deep cover for Rysina herself. Yes, don't worry - the Council keeps an eye on us!
Meet with Elizaveta Rysina at Yasker's Tower in Nezebgrad.

I have requested the codes from the Council, basing on the information that you have collected. Remember those factory markings on the Mechanoids? I decided to apply the standard master control to try and switch off the mechanical army. You have seen the result. I suppose we have no other way out but to fight them all.

However, the fact they react to the control device says something. I'm afraid there was no "independent party" - we are dealing with the old Imperial technology... That somehow was ahead of its time by a couple of centuries.

But still, we don't know what Tep had to do with it. And as you remember, he was one of the greatest technological geniuses...

I can feel that we are close to the answer. And now you have to meet Elizaveta Rysina. She will tell you everything you have to know about our mission.

Well, hello again!

Have you really thought that this tiny Zayan's expedition on the huge Darkblood Citadel will remain unnoticed by the Council? Without a twinge of conscience you decided to conceal such important information from us. Oh, I clearly understand your motives, but I strongly recommend you get rid of your stupid hero's complex. Don't forget that the strength of the Empire - and the Council in particular - is in our unity. First of all, you're the citizen on the Empire! It's a shame that Elena Zimina understands that, and you don't. What if there is no one around to help you out in the moment of need?..

But said enough about that. As far as I understand, you have got into trouble on Ferris, is that right? I hope you have at least a decent report on what is going on.

I've told you everything I knew. Sorry, I haven't found out anything new since.

After those kidnappings and your mysterious disappearance everyone in the camp has been watching after each other. I can feel someone's gaze on my back all the time. Either Murk, or Herbert, and now the Prowls, too. They are afraid to lose someone else, and I can understand that. But it's just impossible to work under such conditions!

And you know... It seems that Herbert... erm... has fallen in love with me. Don't get me wrong, he's a nice man in every respect... but I'm on duty! I don't know what to do about him.
h: Ask about the "Gates" project and its connection to Tep Cultists.

t:
I'm afraid I don't know much more than you do. And I don't like it!

After those kidnappings and your mysterious disappearance everyone in the camp has been watching after each other. They are afraid to lose someone else, and I can understand that. Everyone will be on their toes if anything happens.

Herbert has been keeping an eye on me. Sometimes it seems to me that... erm... he has fallen in love with me. Don't get me wrong, he's a nice man in every respect... but I'm on duty! We work together! I don't know what to do about him.
h: Ask about the "Gates" project and its connection to Tep Cultists.

t: Weird things happen around. The more I know, the more I want to get away from here.

You think this crystal caused the mutation? It is hard to believe that. Those mutations are random, there are no two similar cases, so I think it would be more accurate to call it modification - a deliberate interference into the living organisms - rather than mutation.

I think you should talk to Herbert. He knows more about these things.
Give transmitter to Elena Zimina at the Eastern Terminal on Ferris.

I see. Zimina is an exceptional agent, and she justified my expectations. Of course, you don't need to know her real name. I will tell you something about her, so that you know who you have the honor to work with. She's been investigating the case about the implementation of the liquidation codes into the parcels of Spinners, which were built based on the Tep's technology, as you know. It was Elena who discovered that one of the Tycoons on the Death Plant was involved in that shady business, and thus saved thousands of lives.

Then after what happened with the Historians and Gorluxor, we decided to withdraw our bailiffs, and planted Zimina in the ranks of scientists instead. Initially it had nothing to do with Spinners, but now, as I study the report from Ferris, I can see that the story has finally gained traction. We need to find out what was the connection between Tep and Ferris as soon as possible, and why do Mechanoids carry the Imperial marking from the times of Nezeb and use our technology. If it was actually a secret Imperial object, believe me - I would have known of it. But I have heard nothing neither of Ferris nor the Bestiary.

I will keep in touch with Zimina using this transmitter. Bring it to her and provide her with any assistance she needs. And remember - in any emergency situation the Council is ready to interfere. I am really bothered by that Elf who leads the expedition. I have a feeling that I've met him before...

The Spinners, you say? Huh, of course, I remember the case... I'd never thought it would get back at me this way. Did Rysina say anything else?

Alright. I suppose we need to move on! It's good to know that the Council supports us, don't you think? On the other hand, I'm afraid our machination has been noticed. Murk keeps on looking at me strangely... I think he suspects something.

But let's get down to work. Vincent wanted to ask you something.
Sneak up to Elena Zimina's bag and give a sign to Murk. Examine the bag and, if you find anything peculiar, bring it to Murk at the Eastern Terminal.

Hrrm... Aho, friend. Wait a second. Look at Zimina. Look closer. Do you see anything, zoor?

Neither do I. But I swear on all Golases, she smells with mystery. And I don't like mysteries!

Listen to me. I saw her stealing several tools from Vincent's tool box the other day. She didn't just borrow them, she stole them! Only a complete akara can't see the difference. And then she went through Mekhdi's drrawer and took several parts of the walking tin cans.

I don't know why she would need them, and why she couldn't just ask for them. I think it will be fair to do the same and cheat on her.

The plan is simple. I will distract her, and you will go through her bag. Don't argue, eysh! I've known human females for long enough to know that it is easier to get lost in their bags than in the thickets of Howlem!
The longer I live, the less prride I have. Came down to stealing! Ay-hya!
Huh... What is that? Some strange thing with a button. Once I saw a miner who had a thing like that. A detonator it was called. You think I should press it?
Test the Master Controller on Mechanoid M-3. Tell Herbert de Vevre about Murk's conjecture.

On the other hand, it doesn't really look like a detonator. Maybe it's some kind of a controlling device, zoor?

Huh... Since Zimina stole some parts of the walking tin cans, this thing can prrobably have something to do with them. We just need to sneak up to a Mechanoid, prress the button, and see what happens... Don't chicken! How bad can it be? This thing can't become more of a hunhurr than it already is!

I will stick around and distrract Zimina so that she doesn't notice anything. And you go find a Mechanoid - a large one - and try this thing!

And you know what. Ask Herbert what he thinks of Zimina. I can do that myself, and I will do later, but I wonder what he will say to you.
Hey there! It's such a nice day to explore the new lands!

Zimina is scheming behind our backs? Phew, that's the most stupid thing I've heard since we arrived on Ferris. You should take a rest, my friend. Why would you think that? Elena is loyal to our mission, and she is doing everything to contribute to the expedition's success! Believe me - I've known her longer than you have. This girl has sacrificed so much to be among her colleagues, where she is loved and esteemed... Ahem.

On the top of that, I've worked with the League Investigators a lot, so I can easily sense any scheming or spying. Don't worry, if there is a mole among us, I will surely bring them out into the open.

Speaking of which...
Talk to Izbor Yavorsky in the Aidenus' Tower in Novograd.

I think you need to wind down and step into the civilized world again. Return to Novograd, walk through its streets, feel the hustle of the city. And while you are walking, stop by Izbor Yavorsky. Yes, you remember him.

I think it's time to inform the League Defenders of what is going on. I know we can't be certain about anything yet, and we still have dozens of unanswered questions. But personally, I would feel more confident if I knew that the best brains of the League were trying to puzzle through the mysteries of Ferris, too.

Come back soon! We shouldn't stay here for too long.
Greetings! The day becomes much more interesting when you show up at the doorstep. I see you are willing to tell me something.
Give transmitter to Herbert de Vevre at the Eastern Terminal on Ferris.

Well, well... I see you've been pretty busy behind our backs! Herbert turns out to be a ready-witted man. He's not our leader for nothing, after all! But all elves are like that. If you still didn't know that, he's one of the best agents of the Detective Bureau who was sent to join the Historians after what happened with Gorluxor.

Your words made me think of the Spinners, the ones that Tycoons fabricated at the Death Plant. Why? Just think of it - is Tep involved? He is. Is the Empire involved? It is indeed! So I'm wondering what are these "Gates" and "the Bestiary", and what do they have to do with all that. If Tep and the Empire had been working together for all this time... Then probably we have avoided destiny much more terrifying we'd thought - thanks to you.

I will surely keep in touch with Herbert at all times now. Take this artifact and bring it to him. And tell him from me to open his eyes and watch Zimina closely. The Great Game is not as tricky as Xadaganian intrigues! We can't let her turn the elf around her little finger because he has a crush on her.

Oh, stop picking on me, you great advisors. So she's an Imperial spy. Thank you very much, you have opened my short-sighted eyes. Are you happy now?

Ah... I'm sorry, I should keep it together. Of course, I had certain suspicions regarding miss Zimina. But I'd never thought that Murk would figure that out. How did he do that? He sensed "the smell of mystery"? Ha! As if I would believe that. He's much smarter than he seems to be. I guess he likes to maintain the image of an ingenuous but astute creature. Well, I'd give him that.

We should get back to work. By the way, Vincent wanted to ask you something.
Help Surveyors explore the Lab Complex by completing their quests, then meet Herbert in the Central Laboratory.
Ferris conceals so many mysteries. Maybe the key to them is hidden in the central laboratory of the complex.... But who knows what else we will find as we explore the "Gates" Project?
Methodism and scientific approach - that's our motto!

I expected anything but meeting myself!

I can't stop wondering, why would anyone do that? Why create clones and modify them? I'm sure one day I will meet their creator and beat all the answers out of him...

Now we need to study the Object. The whole complex was build because of this thing, and we still can't figure out what it is!
Set up the portable Analyzer in the three areas around the station. Eliminate 5 Mechanoids in each area near the working scanner and return to Elena Zimina.

Mechanoids again! Do you want to finish this as fast as possible? Then listen.

We know their basic construction. The problem is these ones were produced in here, and their schemes were reworked... So their previous flaws could have been improved.

Luville has developed an interesting device. Here it is! The Fragility Analyzer - it can recognize Mechanoids' weak spots after several fights. Just activate it in several areas of the station and eliminate some Mechanoids. You will helps us a great deal!
This squeaking and the smell of engine oil drive me insane...
The recordings are ready! Alright, I need to give them to Luville when she comes. We won't let Mechanoids hold us back for too long!
Eliminate three Mechanoid commanders near the station and report to Herbert de Vevre.

Local Mechanoids behave rather strangely. They act precisely, sharply, and cooperate with each other. I think I know why it is so.

You see, any machine, however intelligent it is, needs command. Basically, they are just mobile turrets. Which means something, or someone, is controlling them.

I saw several exceptionally large Mechanoids around here. Probably, they are those "commanders". We should get rid of them first, before we deal with the rest of the machines.
They don't seem to be intricate mechanisms, but believe me, their appearances are deceitful!

Well done! One day we will eliminate all of them!

You say, there is a huge Mechanoid, surrounded by a force field? Interesting. I wonder what shall we do if it attacks the camp. But it is clearly protecting something important. Now we know where we need to go!
Fix 5 Mechanoids M-4 and report to Elena Zimina.

Listen to me closely. A friend of mine, who works at the Council, has studied the Analyzer's readings from the Mechanoids. Now I have the access codes! We can control them! Take this device - it can reconfigure a Mechanoid before it goes into the battle mode.

Now we have our personal guards, and also we can provide the Empire with a new technology!

But here is the problem. Some of the Mechanoids showed slightly different readings, which means there is a chance that they will attack you if you try to reprogram them. Be careful.

Well, the Council only recruits the best warriors. Now we have a serious advantage over the Mechanoids... and the League. I'm sure Detective Bureau agents will soon be here, otherwise I will be slightly disappointed. Remember, we need to be very cautious!

Now we have more pressing problems to solve.
Reconfigure 5 Mechanoids M-4 and report to Herbert de Vevre.

Great job! Now we know almost everything about these Mechanoids, and we can stand against them. Of course, we are never completely safe...

This device will allow us to control Mechanoids in the area. I used the readings that we obtained with the Fragility Analyzer and borrowed some spare transmitter parts to rebuild one simple elven device. At least it works!

We need to test it as soon as possible! Of course, you will have to do that.

So, our method works! We just need to develop it, then we will be safe.

If we provide the League with this technology, we will have something to match against Imperial Mechanoids!
Search wreckages of Tep's Mechanoids around the station. Report to Herbert de Vevre.

There are plenty of these weird machines around here. Mostly they are Imperial. But some of them look different, and newer. They must be Tep's machines, zoor? I wonder who they were fighting...

It is clear that we are following the right track. We are getting closer to the answers! I think we should search these wrecked machines, zoor?

If you find anything interesting, brring it to Herbert. I won't touch these tin cans, eysh!
What's the matter? I'm busy right now.

What is that? You decided to disassemble Tep's Mechanoids? Have you forgotten about the self-destruction systems and basic safety precautions? You're lucky they were build a century ago - they are completely non-functional.

Well, this part seems to be intact... I will take it and think what use it can make.
Obtain 10 Mana Batteries and bring them to Elena Zimina.

I think this laboratory was generously financed. Just look at all this equipment, packed in boxes and scattered all over the quarter! I bet we will find something useful in them.

I am particularly interested in spare energy elements for the Mechanoids. I think we will find use for them.

Can you bring me some ten?
Wow, ten batteries! And they are all functional. I think we don't need more! Thank you!
Defeat the Lab gate-keeper using the reprogrammed Mechanoids. Ally Mechanoids must not be destroyed!

Now we need to get inside the Lab. Have you seen that huge Mechanoid at its gates? I think I have finally figured out how its shield works. A very intricate system - you will need fire power of another Mechanoid to disable it for a while.

But since we have an army of Mechanoids of our own, this won't be a problem! I will order several Mechanoids to guard you and protect you in battle.

As soon as you handle this, go to Herbert and inform him. He needs to be cheered up a bit!
What? I'm sorry, I'm a little bit busy here.

Ah, good morning! It seems like you black out every time you commit a great feat! Are you alright? You feel well?

May I ask you whether you had any visions during your pass-out? No? Ah, I thought you could give us some clues. We need them badly right now...
Help Murk, the Sharp Family, Semer Hatshah, and Makar Osokin study the external part of the Laboratory. Report to Herbert de Vevre.

Oh, I'm so anxious... Each day we are getting more questions than answers!

But we must be cautious, for even a small mistake can cost us the whole expedition. Who knows what this complex conceals!

Before we move on, I want to make sure we haven't missed anything. All Surveyors are now searching the external part of the Laboratory, and I would be grateful if you could help them.
No haste, no mess - this is our motto!
Honestly, I was expecting more. Anyway, we need to get inside of the Laboratory.
Kill 10 Spiked Echidnas in the Scientific Quarter and report to Murk.

Back in my homeland, we have plenty of weird animals, but I've never seen anything like that. Luville calls them echidnas, but I'd rather call them a true disaster, eysh! They've wrecked my favorite boots, and they were made of finger-thick leather, I swear on my ancestors!

And what if someone less careful steps on them? We need to get rid of them as soon as possible!
I wonder if the echidnas are edible? Though I remember what they were eating themselves... No, I will stick with the canned food.
Grreat, eysh! Echidnas won't leave us alone, but at least they won't get in the way. Unlike those annoying gibberlings...
Obtain 10 old spare parts in the Scientific Quarter and bring them to Makar Osokin.

I have a very responsible mission for you!

We managed to reprogram several Mechanoids, but they are more of walking trash cans than of combat machines.

I can patch them up a little, but I still need spare parts. So if you come across some screws or nuts or something like that - bring them to me!
I never thought Imperial science was so advanced... I guess neither did the Council!
Great. On behalf of all working people, meaning me and Luville, I sincerely thank you. Let's try and make something useful out of this pile of metal. Herbert will be happy!
Use the Face of Death to resurrect the dead cultists in the Scientific Quarter until you manage to interrogate one of them, and return to Semer Hatshah.

Well, well... I can't help but notice that there are several Arisen among the withered bodies. I think it wouldn't even be wrong to assume that they were faithful apologists of Tep. Which means they can tell us what Tep had to do with this place!

Here, take this mask. It is called the Face of Death. It can return the Spark to a dead body for a short time. If it works, maybe we will find out something important!
I wonder whether Tep Cultists were here before the Laboratory stopped working, or came after?

Well, well... this is very interesting! It's a shame that cultist didn't say more. But still he said something.

That Source that Tep was looking for... Maybe it caused the mutations of all those animals in the Bestiary? This is the kind of technology Tep could be interested in! He was a genius, though a mad genius. That's very, very interesting!

We should get into the central laboratory as soon as possible. But who was that Negus Jeeg?
What... Where is Negus Jeeg? That filthy jackal that betrayed our Master? I will tear his heart out and feed it to desert centipedes, I swear on the three Pillars of Truth!

How dare you open your mouth in the presence of someone who has been through all the nine stages of torment? Impudent worm!

Answer me, slave, where is the Source? It must be somewhere near, and your stupid robots won't stop us! Jeeg - may his name be cursed! - has betrayed our Master! He fooled your stupid Nezeb, your dumb scientists, who thought they could fathom the divine nature of the Source... But he didn't fool us!

Where is the Source, slave?!
What?! I will tear your lying tongue out! One cannot deceive those who have seen the truth!
Help the Sharp Family inspect 5 houses in the Scientific Quarter.

Hey! We could use some help here.

We want to search several houses in the Scientific Quarter. Maybe we can find out where everyone has gone?

Though we're too scared to go on our own. What if some beast sneaks on us from behind? We need you to keep a look out for us. Can you do that?
We succeeded more than I thought we would!

Is this thing... Dead? Are you sure? That's a pity...

Looks like this creature used to be a scientist once. At least the pass that you've found says so. Probably this is what a human being, affected by the Bestiary mutation, turns into. Could it be that all the local staff ended up like this? Such a terrible fate! I really wouldn't wish to share it with them...
Open the door to the Central Laboratory.

Well, we need to move on. For now, we only know that Tep cultists were looking for some "Source", but were killed. Maybe the Lab was sealed because of them... But it seems to me that Tep came here only later. And what confuses me most, we still haven't found any traces of the Priden Shoom Branch...

You've been very helpful. The pass that you've found will help us get inside of the Central Laboratory. If it works, very soon we will find the answers to our questions...
Come on, open the doors! I hope the pass will work...

Damn it! It was worth a shot.

I think the building was sealed for a reason. First we thought that the local guards were fighting cultists, but that modified creature that you've discovered, and also those damaged Mechanoids suggest that it was not quite so. Probably they were fighting something else, too...
Meet Sarbaz Baybut in the Sanitation Zone.

Anyway, we need to get inside. Our Surveyors have discovered something interesting outside the Scientific Quarter. I don't know for sure what it is, but probably it will help us break into the Lab. Also, if we don't find any other way, there is that huge bomb that Luville has been working on... Though I'm afraid the only thing that will be left after its explosion is a giant smoking crater and our scorched bodies all over the allod. So you better meet Sarbaz Baybut before Luville finishes working on it.
Finally, somebody came for us! I thought mutated rabbits and cockroaches ate you all, haha.
Talk to Grigory Chilin and Gerard de Desirae in the Surveyors' camp outside the secured perimeter and return to Sarbaz Baybut.

We've been searching the Scientific Quarter, and we have discovered something peculiar. You must have noticed that the perimeter around the Central Laboratory was hastily built in order establish defenses against something. All the Mechanoids, all other defensive systems are concentrated in a circle around the laboratory. This is rather strange, don't you think?

You should listen to what my colleagues have to say.
Talk to my colleagues. They have something to say.

I agree with my colleagues. All lines of defense were built in haste, and they all face the Central Laboratory. No survivors. Mechanoids are set in the attacking mode and uncontrollably assault everyone they see.

Searching for something under such conditions is pretty tough...
Use the Master Key to destroy or subject 10 Mechanoids on the secured perimeter and return to Grigory Chilin.

So here is the thing. While there are still hordes of tin cans rambling around, we cannot resume our research. So, we need to get rid of them.

We have two options. We can just brutally wreck them, but also we can make them work for us. I saw Elena use an ingenious device that can control them... Here, I have one, too.
Don't waste time. We can't make it out of the barricades while these Mechanoids are around.
Alright, minus several tin cans. Now we can search other barricades. Most probably, we will find something that deserves our attention.
Search three barricades within the secured perimeter and return to Grigory Chilin.

We need to find out what happened here. And find a way to get in...

I think we should start with searching those barricades, were most of the defenders died. Look for anything that can help us turn off the quarantine mode - logs, notebooks, orders, diaries. Maybe keys or devices.
Bring everything that you will find on the barricades. Anything might prove useful.

What do we have here...

It's a log. Reports, assignments... here it is! The last record says that the commander of the defenders, Igor Otvagin, ordered to break through to the Laboratory and turn on the quarantine mode... Well, they must have succeeded in that. But how do we turn it back off?

This piece of paper that you've found is very interesting! It looks like its a death note of one of the volunteers. He wrote that they were fighting "scientists who had turned into monsters". Well, now it is clear - they must have messed up their experiments and turned into mutated beasts like those we saw in the Bestiary.

And finally, that device that you've found. I'm not a great technician, but I am pretty sure it works like my Master Key. It can control robots. Look, the buttons have labels.

It seems to be broken, but don't worry, I will find a way to fix it! Meanwhile, go to Sarbaz Baybut. He has some crazy idea again.
Try and reprogram the Mechanical Adder in the Sanitation Zone and return to Sarbaz Baybut.

I have an idea... a crazy one, but it can work!

I noticed small Mechanoids in the Sanitation Zone - they look like serpents. So I am wondering, why would they need mechanical snakes? I think they could have been used as spying devices. We could reprogram one of those snakes and send it to inspect the lab without risking our lives...

Take the Master Key. I've improved it a little...
Did it work? Have you fixed the adder?

Is this all that was left of the adder? Well... We need a new theory.

Wait! I've seen these "mechanical eyes" before. They work pretty much like deserotypes! Which means we can see what this eye saw! Give it to me!

Now, that's you, with a puzzled face and the smoking Master Key.

And that must be Otvagin with his soldiers! Such a heroic face!

And there goes the interesting part! The "monstrous scientists" are breaking through the barricades. We were right - they look just like the beasts from the Bestiary. Look at that soldier - he is controlling a giant Mechanoid, using a device that looks like the one that you've found... Now I know how we can break in!
Obtain a focusing lens from the old turrets in the Sanitation Zone and bring it to Gerard de Desirae.

I've inspected the device that Grigory gave me. He may be a good mechanic, though he is not too bright. I noticed the cracked lens right away - we use the same principle in some of our instruments.

To get this device to work, we need to replace the lens. I would search the turrets in the Sanitation Zone in the first place.
Have you found an intact lens yet?
Ah! Just look at this surface and the precision of the faceting! Those Imperial researchers were way ahead even of contemporary science.
Destroy 10 Carnivorous Hemlocks near the secured perimeter and return to Gerard de Desirae.

Oh, my head... It's like I have scorching needles stuck into my forehead...

It's the Hemlock! And no, it's not the type that mixtures are made of. Local Hemlock is huge and ravenous - it can bite your foot off!

I'm allergic to the damned plant. I get such terrible headaches that I can't even think, which makes my presence here not only painful but useless. Will you help me?
I cannot work with the spores of those damned plants twisting in the air!
Ah, finally! We can breathe freely now, and the headache is fading. Thank you!
Find 10 soldier tokens among the bodies near the barricades and bring them to Grigory Chilin.

The Empire never leaves those fallen in battle behind. Unfortunately, not a single defender has survived to give their fellow soldiers a decent burial... That's not fair! We must know the names of the heroes who gave up their lives in the name of scientific progress!

Please, find the tokens of the diseased soldiers. When we get out of here, I will send them to the Imperial Keepers.
As Nezeb said: "The one who does not have respect for the past, does not have the future!"
What kind of science demands human sacrifice?
Bring the controlling device to Elena Zimina at the entrance to the Central Laboratory.

So, we have not wasted our time in vain. We know what we are going to face inside of the laboratory, we know who our enemy is, and we know how to get in! Do you get it?

This device that you've found can be used to control Mechanoids inside of the lab. Bring it to Zimina, she will tell you what to do.
Have you found a way to get in yet?
So Sarbaz Baybut thinks that we can control one of the Mechanoids inside of the lab using this device? Let me see. You know, this might work!
Use the Controlling Device to control the Mechanoid and open the Laboratory gates from the inside.

It's all simple - just push the button to establish connection with an active Mechanoid inside of the lab, and then you will be able to control it! Find a switch or something else that might open the doors.

If some of the mutated scientists are still alive inside of the Laboratory, they will try to attack the Mechanoid. I hope its weapons are still working.
This place is so weird... I can't believe the Empire was so ahead of us in its developments. It's such a shame that everything was lost.
Take the Mana-train, go to the Central Laboratory, and speak to Murk.

Together with Luville we have inspected the Manarail - don't worry, it won't crash again! However, we don't know what is waiting for us at the destination. The old map says the next station is called "Central Laboratory". Sounds promising!

I will go there with you, Murk, and Elena. If there are automatized defense systems waiting for us, we need to deal with them as soon as possible, and check the area for other threats. I will meet the rest of the expedition at the station. Call on me if you need help.

Good luck!
It smells with death, eysh! This smell will be here for thousands of years. And I think I know where it is coming from.
Upload data to the input terminal and receive deciphered data at the output terminal. Return to Herbert de Vevre.

Everything's almost ready! We just need to make some final adjustments.

I have a small request. While I try to figure out the internal part of this system, please take these plates to the terminals in the next room. These are called punch cards. They store more information than it might seem. The terminals are designed to read that information and decipher it. As soon as you get it, come back to me.

Most likely they some contain valuable information regarding the Sarcophagus, so we better check it out before we start experimenting.
Everything is almost done. Do you have the required data?

There's so much... But only several pages refer to the Sarcophagus. Well, at least that's something. Thank you anyway.

We pin our hopes on you!
Take the elevator down to the Source's Mine and receive further directions from Herbert de Vevre.

Alright... We mustn't panic. We just need to reach that sphere. It can't run away from us, can it? Think, Herbert, think...

We have only one option - we must chase it! From what I've seen in the schemes, there is an underground part of the complex somewhere below us. There must have been a separate lab department, but what were they doing down there? The good thing is, Luville has fixed the elevator, and we can take it down there.

We need to assemble a special team. You, Murk and Elena will go down there. The primary scouting mission is on you, as usual. I will be right after you!

Oh my...

It doesn't look like an utility room, does it? It could house a whole ship yard! Damn it! And the Object must have fallen all the way down to the bottom. I can't see anything from here... I wonder if it remained intact.

Let's set a small camp here. We need to figure out what this place is and why there are so many modificants in here! Will you take a look around? Murk and Elena Zimina will go with you.

Let's do it!
Search one of the labs on the first floor of the Mine. Report to Herbert de Vevre.

Herbert must be blaming himself for what happened back in the lab.

Well, who knew that its floor could open up? It looks like so far we've only seen the top of the iceberg. This Mine was never mentioned in any of the documents that we saw. It's like a card-castle of mysteries!

We need to find out what this construction is and what is was built for. We should search the local labs.

Bring everything that you find important! And watch out for the modificants - this place is swarming with them. Take Murk with you.
What a weird instruction... We need to figure it out as soon as possible.

Well, well... That mysterious Source supplies all this... construction, whatever it is. Could it be that this is a plant room, where staff isn't supposed to be when the machine is operating?

Hm... I wasn't going to expose the expedition members to mana-radiation, you see. So now we might probably have to evacuate...

It's not a single dull moment in here!
Kill 10 modificants and report to Herbert de Vevre.

Ay-hya... I don't like the eyes of these dead men. You may call them "mofidicants" or whatever, but they have been long dead. And I don't care what kind of a hunhurr controls them. You know what I do care about?

About the fact they stand in our way, eysh! Let's chop them to pieces, and that's it. They would even thank us for that! Am I right or not, zoor?

Kill some ten of them and tell Herbert the way is clear. I will warm up myself, too...

Great. The less we stumble into these creatures, the better. I just hope the Empire won't give us any trouble. Yes, don't look at me like that! They can easily blame us for slaying Imperial citizens! It is something much more believable than a power that turns people into... these things.

Well, I will take care of it later. Now let's move on!
Go down to the second floor of the Mine and activate the Transportation Node. Report to Herbert de Vevre.

Well, I think we can no longer be afraid of a rear attack. You and Murk did a good job. It's a shame we can't find out what you saw in that lab. But don't worry, we will in due time. And for now...

We need to go on! There is only one way to get to the second floor - that staircase down below. There is also some good news, too! I have finally figured out what was that device on the spur. It has a core made of a material, similar to that of the Adventurer's Stone. So basically, it's a teleporting device based on June technology. I think there is a device like that one on each floor.

But first we need to reach them on foot and activate them. Go to the node on the next floor - I will meet you there.
We have no time to waste!

Wake up! You have a talent for getting into trouble.

The node was protected by a spell. This magic seems unusual, but still quite primitive... What? Another vision? Elena? What are you talking about?
Ask Elena Zimina about the panama found in the lab.

...This panama definitely belongs to Elena. But what is it doing here?

If she had already been here, why would she need our help? Wait, we should question her.

What? My panama? I can't be. Here is mine, where it should be. I've never been to those labs!

Something's wrong... You see, there can't be another panama like this one. It was sewn by an individual design by the best tailors of Nezebgrad. Unbelievable. It even has my initials on it!

It turns out... One of that monsters, created by Jeeg, is wandering somewhere around? I knew we wouldn't get rid of them easily! it gives me the chills...

Alright, let's not panic. You already met my clones. We will deal with this one as well. Am I right?
Clear the way of modified slugs and find Elena Zimina at the second floor of the Mine.

So, this homuncle is still here... What does he need? What was that - a warning or a threat?

Oh great Astral, we need to find Zimina! What if that monster has already reached her? I knew I shouldn't have let them go.

The time is not on our side again. And there is no way down to the third floor to be seen! Damn this Imperial architecture. Our scouts must be in a serious danger...

Hurry up - follow Zimina, and I will try and find Murk! It's just... this floor is swarming with aggressive slugs. I'm afraid we will have to fight our way through.
Don't just stand there, help me!

Oh, here comes the cavalry! Look at my gun. Do you like it?

Remember how a bunch lynxes cornered me in the snow, in the very beginning of the expedition? Well, I could definitely use it back then!
Find Murk deep in the caves of the Mine.

What? So my clone is here after all? Oh Nezeb, I hoped it just... well, disappeared? Died? Ran away? I don't know.

It looks like it needs something here. I wonder what it is capable of. I doubt that it can just attack us... Herbert is right - we should stick together.

Come on, let's find Murk. I know where he went. I hope Herbert has already caught up with him. Look, here's the entrance to the cave complex. I don't know what's in there, but probably it will lead us to the lower floor.

Let's go!

I don't believe a single word she says. Something just does not hang together.

Herbert is Charles de Doucer, a scientist from the rebellious house that fell under Tep's influence? Why would he end up as a Historian on Avilon? I don't believe it.

Well... I think now we have even more questions to answer.
Follow the trail of the clone and Herbert in the mountains.

It... it attacked from behind. Herbert warned me rright in time, and I almost got that nasty thing! But them I was hit in the head. Damn magic!

I remember Herbert trrying to fight back. He was casting spells... but I guess he couldn't defeat the clone, too. Ay-hya, everything's doubling in my eyes!

We need to follow them! I can see her traces everywhere. We can still catch up with them!

So, you are here. All of you. Well, some of you turned out to be more stupid than I expected...

You are still hoping to save your precious Herbert? Haven't you understood it yet? Everything's so clear.

I don't care about my prototype. She can live on her pathetic life. I only need Herbert.

He is destined to great things. I understand it, and he does, too. I don't need you to understand.

Anyway, the puzzlement on your faces looks amusing. I wonder what else your faces can look like.

You see... Herbert's real name is not Herbert. He is Charles, I'm sure you have heard of him. Charles de Doucer, the scientist who turned away from Tep.

He devoted his life to the search of perfection. And now he found... me!

I! I will grant him perfection! And you will turn into ashes if you stand in our way.
Weirrrd things are happening... Elena is not Elena, zoor?

That was one good fight, eysh! I hope next time she sends someone bigger!

But what in the name of Golases was that thing? I don't remember seeing anything like it here on Ferris. Maybe it's a new kind of a tin can, zoor?

No... It must be something different. Mark my words, kylys - this hunhurr will bite us in the tail! Watch out.
Why are you here? Chasing me is pointless.

Well, you are not a master of provocation, but we should try.

I don't have time for personal squabbling. I can use the local resources to crush you like annoying flies.

You won't reach me and Herbert. We cannot let you, not now. We are preparing to enter a better world, a world free of your disgusting chaos. Our love will overcome all obstacles!
h: Provoke the clone and bring it into an honest fight

t:
Arrgh! If this pseudo-Zimina wants a war, she will get it, eysh! We will come for her head. And while we will be coming, she will hear our every step! May she trry and stop us, if she dares!

Has she stopped looking? Ah, I can stop playing the fool now. Whether she is from the Council or not - we can find it out later. For now, we have this stupid door in our way. What are we going to do with it? Gnaw it? We can, but it will take us a while...

I have a better idea. Herbert wouldn't have approved of it, huh. Let's blow this door up, and that's it! There are cans with fuel everywhere around here. They smell old, but they will do. If we add some bile of the local critters, it will make a fine explosive! A secret Priden recipe, eysh!
Is everything ready? Don't waste time!

Shoysh, what s stench! Sometimes having a nose better than one of a dog comes with a prrice...

Alright. So, we blend it... in a prroportion... Ah, by rule of thumb!

Get down!

I'm joking! Hahaha, you should see your face.

It is rready for exploding!
Blow up the bunker door in the cave complex of the Mine and report to Elena Zimina.

You will have all the fun. And the dirty work, too. I couldn't do it all myself, zoor? I was the brrain of the operation!

Here, take it. It's a bomb.

Plant it near the door and run as fast as you can! Cover your head - just in case.

We should talk to Zimina about that Council of hers later. Something wicked is going on here...

Are you out of your minds?! The cave almost collapsed! I can still hardly hear myself!

Alright, I will open the next door myself!

Don't yell at me!
Speak to Murk and tell Elena Zimina about the plan.

Well, now we know for sure that monster knows how to pull our strings. The problem is, she has all my memories at her disposal, so she knows everything about me, she can foresee my every step. And get at our nerves. Ah, I will kill her!

We need help. Speak to Murk. See if he believes the words of that... clone. Probably we will have to lay some cards on the table. He likes you much better than me. I am just his ally, and you his friend, I guess. That means a lot for Pridens.

We need to stick together! The clone will try to put us at odds with each other and separate us. That's what I would do. We cannot let her do this.
Things are getting out of control.

Well, he's always had a head on his shoulders, that's for sure. He is still with us, and that's the most important. I would have.... we would have never hurt Herbert! Imagine the political scandal!

Now let's get working.
Use the Spark projector to contact Elizaveta Rysina.

It's simple - if the situation gets out of control, we need to have more cards up our sleeve. We should get the Council involved. But we don't have the time to send someone to the capital. Luckily, we don't have to.

You remember that transmitter that Rysina gave you? It's not actually a transmitter... It is called a Spark Projector, designed specifically to instantly contact anyone you want. You can sit in a room full of people, and nobody will even suspect that you are talking to someone else. Obviously, Rysina has the receiver. A kind of an Astralophone, but in this case you decide for yourself when you want to appear before the other person.

Here, take it. I think you will figure out how it works. Meanwhile, we will take a look around together with Murk.
Do you have something to tell me?

Well, how do you like it? What did Rysina say?

...That's encouraging. But it's not that simple. Murk has thrown dust in our eyes. He knew about our plan and somehow contacted the League on behalf of Herbert. Let's say, they responded readily.

We have just summoned two best battle troops of Sarnaut's biggest archenemies. I have a bad feeling about that.
Speak to Murk about Elena Zimina.

You must be wondering whether that creature was telling the truth or not? Well, I must admit, not everything that she says is a lie.

There was I time when I used to work for the Council. I can't say I was such an exceptional agent. Just one of the many. Maybe, someday I will tell you why I decided to leave. If we survive this. I don't like to talk about it. You know, nobody leaves the Council for no reason.

Thoughts must have mixed up in the clone's head. It's not so easy to get through someone else's memory, I guess... it's easy to confuse things that happened yesterday and ten tears ago. I promise you, I'm on your side. And I want to find Herbert just as much as you do!

Don't take trouble to retell me - I heard everything. Cubs on Howlem don't make to the mature age without a sharp ear.

As she said herself: "not everything that she says is a lie". But right there she was lying as sure as death, eysh! Honestly, I don't know who can be trrusted. I look at Herbert and Zimina and all I see is their masks. But lies are always easier to spot than the truth, zoor?

We need to get some solid ground beneath our feet before we drown like blind kittens.
Here everything smells with rrot. And lies.

I don't know, kylys. I know that she is lying, and that you are playing along with her. Only a fool doesn't see that.

The question is, why are you doing this. If I find out that you are going to hurt Herbert or leave him behind, you will pay for that, rest assured. Everyone may have secrets, but as long as you don't mess with our mission, I don't care.

Am I being clear?
h: Ask what Murk thinks of Zimina

t: Talk to Izbor Yavorsky in the Aidenus' Tower in Novograd.

Let us forget about the net of lie that surrounds us. A simple question, kylys - what do we know for sure?

First, we just fought a creature like no one has ever seen before. Secondly, whatever this thing down below is, it looks like that creature, which means it is definitely dangerous. Thirdly, Zimina wants to lay her hands on everything. And that is bad. That's all I care about rright now, eysh!

Whoever Herbert is, the League Defenders know him. They also know something about our mission of Ferris. They even offered help. It is about time we accept the offer.
Do you have something to tell me?
Welcome home, friend! How was your journey to Ferris?
Ensure the support of Marianne de Ardeur and return to Murk on Ferris.

You are telling interesting things... I don't really know much about that Ferris expedition. It was Marianne de Ardeur, the prioress of the Church, who decided to keep an eye on the Historians.

You should go to her and tell her everything. I will do my best to help you - provide you with my best guys. I was wounded recently, so I'm not a great helper right now.

Come on, go, before anyone sees you like that.

Marianne? The prioress? I don't trrust priests. I hope you know what you are doing...

Zimina is messing with us again. While you were away, she contacted somebody from the Empire. I had to corner her, eysh!

She was appealing to the Council.

I should have thrrown her down the chasm! Even now she continues to babble that it was all for Herbert. The worst thing is, I believe her. Ay-hya... Women!

Soon both the League and the Empire will be here. Two bears in one den! We will have to keep them from jumping at each other's throats if we want to get out of here alive!
Defeat four fire throwers deep in the Mine's caves. Report to Murk.

Those dead men who rramble around here... They have flame guns. It is bad.

Tell me, kylys, what do you know of fear? Was there a moment in your life, when your mind was filled with black terror? No thoughts. You are getting blind. You forget how to breathe. You forget who you are.

As a cub, I dreamt of becoming a weaponsmith. The mystery of a blade being born in flames fascinated me. An old smith took me as his apprentice, me of many cubs! I was so prroud, eysh! And I paid for my pride...

When I tried to forge my first blade, I burnt my fur. I was burning so fiercely I lit Howlem brighter than the full moon! The pain didn't come at first. And when it came... Ay-hya. You see, they saved me, after all. But now I keep away from fire.

I cannot handle those dead men on my own, kylys. I need your help.

So, now you know one of my biggest secrets, kylys. Nobody else knows it. Nor Herbert, nor Zimina, nor even Zayan himself. Only several Pridens of my age, but I think most of them are dead. And those who are still alive hardly remember that burnt cub.

I swear to Golases, I wish you never know what a Terror is.

Now let's go, eysh! We need to save Herbert.
Activate three generators in the Mine and come to the locked door.

Now we just need to make the security system work. What are you surprised at? The systems were working once, and now they are deenergized. So the doors were left locked. It's not we who are supposed to open them but the system.

All we have to do is to electrify the door. I think we can do it, using the local generators. Just don't get yourself killed! Yes, you will do this. Meanwhile, I will connect the device to the systems.

As soon as you switch on the power, go to the door. I will show you master's work!

See? It went smooth, with no bombs.

I swear Murk is almost insulted. Well, he had his fun!
Examine the area and clear it of modified cougars. Report to Elena Zimina.

Wow... It's an underground zoo! We will be torn apart if we make a wrong move.

What are these bodies doing here? They all appear to be modificants. Did the animals kill them? Doesn't look like that... We need to figure this out.

Well, there is a good news, too. According to the schemes of the station, the third floor is just around the corner. Me and Murk will go forward, activate the next node and let you know when the way is clear. Meanwhile, take a look around. Be careful - these animals don't look friendly.

Ah, here you are! Right in time.

Everything is going according to the plan. A little bit slowly, but it's alright... As soon as Herbert comes back, things will get back on track, right?

I have a little problem and I need your help.
